messages:
Fiona Chen: Quick coordination thread — candidate Noah Adebayo confirmed for onsite (with remote fallback) on Tue Mar 30. Candidate local arrival 09:30 (GMT+1). Interview loop: 10:00-10:45 system design (Mateo), 11:00-11:30 pair programming (Eng team), 13:00-13:45 product conversation. Noah is vegetarian and requested a quiet prep room and wheelchair ramp access. Can folks confirm badge, parking, laptop/VM, and calendar invites? @Priya Singh can you own visitor badge + accessibility? @Jada Lowe can you send calendar invites + Zoom fallback? @IT Support (bot) can you prepare a loaner laptop image or VM? Also need someone to escort candidate from lobby at 09:15. Thanks!

Mateo Ruiz: I can cover system design and host first session. For the team pair session, please put down Laura N and Ben T as interviewers. Product will be with Camille. For rooms: prefer Conf B (ground floor) for accessibility; if unavailable Conf D works. Parking: will candidate need a permit or do we validate at gate?

Priya Singh: I got this. Visitor badge + NDA flow: we will email the NDA link to Noah this afternoon, and badge will be printed at reception — request a guest pass under "Noah Adebayo". Escort noted for 09:15. Accessibility: ramp is on the east entrance, I'll put that in the check-in note. Dietary: vegetarian lunch OK, will coordinate with catering. Can someone confirm whether Noah needs a laptop loaner or prefers to use his own?

Jada Lowe: Sending invites now. I'll create a 09:15-14:00 'Onsite loop + buffer' calendar block with the detailed room assignments and Zoom link for remote fallback. Zoom fallback link: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/999888777 (use if candidate needs remote). Calendar snippet I will paste into the invites: ```09:15 Reception check-in (escort): Fiona/Recruiting 09:30 Candidate prep (quiet room - Conf L) 10:00-10:45 System design (Conf B / Mateo) 11:00-11:30 Pair programming (Conf D / Laura, Ben) 12:00 Lunch (catered - veg) 13:00-13:45 Product (Conf B / Camille) 14:00 Debrief (small room)``` Please RT availability for Laura/Ben/Camille (they said yes earlier but double-checking). Also I'll add a short note about ramp and mobility. :white_check_mark:

IT Support (bot): Provisioning checklist for Noah: - Loaner laptop: Windows image 'redwood-guest-v2' ready + local account 'guest_noah' - Guest Wi-Fi credentials: Redwood-Guest / expires in 48h - VPN not necessary for onsite interviews; if remote, create temp Zoom co-host on request. Command to provision VM (run by IT): ```create_guest_vm --user noah.adebayo@example.com --image redwood-guest-v2 --expires 2026-03-31``` If you want a machine with specific tools (IDE, repo access) tell me which repos to add.

Facilities: Parking handled — use permit code GUEST-24 at entry kiosk (valid Mar 30 only). If they drive in, show ID + code. Reception will notify security to hold visitor badge at desk. Conf B booked for 10:00-11:00; Conf D booked 11:00-12:00; Quiet room reserved (Conf L) 09:15-10:00. Ramp/access note added to desk for 09:00.

Fiona Chen: Perfect, thanks all. Actions: Priya — email NDA and badge instructions today; Jada — send invites and paste the itinerary + Zoom fallback; IT Support — queue the loaner image and run the create_guest_vm command if candidate requests a VM; Facilities — confirm permit is printable at kiosk. I'll follow up with Noah confirming arrival logistics and add escort to calendar. :thumbsup:

Mateo Ruiz: Thanks team — I'll ping Laura/Ben to reconfirm. If anything changes DM me.

Priya Singh: NDA sent to noah.adebayo@example.com at 14:12. Reception notified for escort.

Jada Lowe: Invites sent to interviewers + candidate at 14:25. Added Zoom fallback and accessibility note.

IT Support (bot): Loaner image staged; VM command queued.

Fiona Chen: All set — marking this thread resolved. Will post a short recap in calendar event notes. :sparkles:
